content:
jordan: Noticed inconsistency in token tallies for account bar-app during a traffic spike. Repro seems tied to router fallback + stream truncation. Two credits for same token range.

leena: Can you paste the minimal trace? streaming or non-streaming? toolcall involved?

jordan: Streaming with interleaved toolcall + fallback to secondary region. Steps: client opens stream -> midstream region swap -> partial chunk replay + aggregator fires -> routing fallback replay confirms the same range. Logs:

```
[2026-02-11T09:03:20Z] session=xyz789 route=primary start_offset=2048 aggregator=flush window_ms=300 tokens=32
[2026-02-11T09:03:20Z] session=xyz789 route=fallback resume_offset=2048 replay_prefetch tokens=32
[2026-02-11T09:03:20Z] ledger.write session=xyz789 offset=2048 tokens=32 counted=true
[2026-02-11T09:03:21Z] aggregator.commit session=xyz789 start_offset=2048 tokens=32
[2026-02-11T09:03:21Z] ledger.write session=xyz789 offset=2048 tokens=32 counted=true <-- duplicate
```

frank: Hmm. Ledger uniqueness is by write_id but both paths generate different ids. We need a canonical key for (session, offset).

hannah: Two mitigation ideas: 1) router side avoid replay if aggregator already committed; 2) mark aggregator writes as provisional so only confirmed on explicit ack.

leena: Option 1 is brittle across region swap. I prefer provisional semantics: aggregator writes provisional=true; the replay/confirm path flips it to provisional=false and triggers billing. Also add TTL so provisional doesn't hang forever.

jordan: Agree. What TTL? 24h feels long. For streaming UX keep 6h default.

frank: Implementation details: add a lightweight index on (session, offset) and store a state field {provisional|confirmed}. Deduplicate at ingest: if a confirmed row exists, drop subsequent writes. If provisional exists and confirm arrives, flip state atomically.

hannah: Telemetry: tag writes with `billing.dedupe=provisional-v2` and emit metric `billing.provisional.count` and `billing.provisional.flip_rate`. Dashboards need provisional vs confirmed breakdown.

jordan: Rollout plan: feature flag `billing.provisional_commits` off by default. Canary on 5% of traffic for 48h, monitor `tokens.delta` and `dedupe.flip_rate`. If flip_rate is near zero, safe to expand.

leena: Console UX: add a filter and column for provisional credits, plus a small banner during canary explaining provisional mechanics. Finance will want a query to find accounts with >0.3% provisional churn.

frank: Edgecase: what if the confirm path never arrives because the client disconnected permanently? TTL job should auto-confirm after 6h and mark `reconciled=true` with note. That prevents permanent dangling provisional state.

jordan: Also capture `dedupe.flip.latency` histogram so we can tune aggregator window.

billing-bot: [ticket] created INF-2026-512 "provisional-ledger-flip - aggregator duplicates" assigned to frank - https://tickets.internal/INF-2026-512

hannah: I can pick the PR for provisional write feature + telemetry. frank please add the index migration and tests. leena will own the dashboard bits. jordan can drive canary.

jordan: Thanks. Ill attach the small repro harness and sample traces to the ticket. Quick win: enable provisional flag for a small canary today after PR merges. :thumbsup:
